basis: Ideal scheduled 20 ms windows applied to the measured deterministic 1,000-client/20-second hotspot workload; modeling only, no batch wire implementation

hypotheticalV2Batch.description: 12-byte envelope + 11-byte batch header + 5 bytes per ordered tile change; contiguous per-school revisions implied by record order

sameTileCoalescing: Not modeled as safe with M2's single-record revisioned DELTA. Skipping intermediate revisions would trigger a client gap and require a new versioned snapshot/batch contract.
